purpose: Define the distinction between transient/read-only DWH projections and explicitly materialized/copied data with new local identity, provenance and governance.

owns: DWH Projection and Materialization Boundary semantics

value.projection_rule: A normal DWH query/projection is transient/read-only unless an explicit write/materialize operation is invoked.
value.identity_rule: Projection does not create a new owned semantic data identity merely by rendering/serializing it.
value.materialize_rule: Materialization/copy creates an explicit destination data identity under an exact owning schema/instance.
value.lineage_rule: Materialized/derived data retains source lineage and transformation provenance.
value.classification_rule: Classification/taint propagates to materialized output according to policy.
value.cache_rule: A cache may store a projection only under an explicit cache profile and never becomes source-of-truth ownership by existence.
value.refresh_rule: Refresh/invalidation semantics are explicit for caches/materialized views.
value.authority_rule: Read access to source does not automatically grant materialization/write authority.
